senses.gloss: turiya (nt. or m.; = Pali id., MIndic for Skt. tūrya), musical instrument; common in vss of LV, e.g. 〔54.6〕 (v.l. tūry˚); 〔161.17〕 (v.l. tūry˚); 〔164.20〕; 〔169.22〕; sometimes turiya and tūrya in the same sentence, LV 〔175.15〕 and 16 (no v.l.). But in Mv 〔iii.122.16〕 (vs) turiya is Senartʼs em., mss. tūrya (which is metrically inferior).
[tūrṇa, (m. or) nt., a high number: Gv 〔105.26〕, read vitūrṇa, q.v., with 〔133.9〕.]
Tūryaghoṣa, n. of a former Buddha: Sukh 〔5.14〕.
